description: Upload a file into the project Files tab (context/). Use file_url (https) for large files. Returns drive file id for calendar generate context attachment.

file_base64.description: Base64 bytes; up to 1 MB decoded (typical PDFs). Larger: file_url or local upload script.

file_url.description: Public https URL (preferred for PDFs, video, large images).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: upload_project_drive_file
